name: How long does kitchen drywall repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen drywall repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixing minor kitchen drywall holes typically takes one to two days, while extensive wall or ceiling replacements require three to five days. The process involves hanging new sheetrock, applying multiple coats of joint compound, allowing proper drying time between layers, sanding, and applying matching paint. In a working kitchen, timing also depends on whether upper cabinets, appliances, or backsplashes must be uninstalled or masked off before repairs can start. If trades like plumbing or electrical rough-ins are required behind the wall first, that coordination adds time before drywall finishing begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor patches take one to two days, while large kitchen repairs take three to five days to allow drywall compound coats to dry fully before sanding, texturing, and painting.
